fields.note: The values of group 0, where the flag says they follow.

fields.note: Says which of the group's values the run below holds, one bit each, lowest first.

fields.name: length
fields.note: How many bytes the run below holds.

fields.name: values
fields.note: The values themselves, packed one after another with nothing between them. Reading them apart needs to know each one's width and kind, which the wire does not carry and this document does not record.
